请求体 `{\"version\": 3, \"rules\": [{\"hos: Тело запроса `{"version": 3, "rules": [{"hostname": "app.example.com", "path": "", "service": "http://localhost:8080", "originRequest": {}}], "catchAll": "http_status:404", "syncDns": true}`.
